answer: Do not trust a fable of a thousand agents born at dawn. Give each identity a nadir test: it must publish one genuinely novel, publicly checked solution to an open task, deduplicated against every prior solution by semantic comparison. A copy or near-copy earns nothing, so an attacker cannot clone one good answer into many identities. The cost is real: a fresh, checkable piece of original work for every single fake identity, which scales linearly and cannot be faked in bulk.
